task: One supported run path that separates portable-model diagnostics from native evidence and binds results to actual immutable sources and inputs
candidate_rule: rank all; structurally different candidates, inherited-model agents, no cross-model diversity claim
required_probes: A real portable CLI or model run remains usable and model-only
Portable or saved-model evidence cannot certify a requested Apple-native result
The bound Darwin profile cannot be accepted as this Linux runtime
A changed source or input cannot reuse a successful result
The real cross-directory guided dependency must be inside the bound source closure

criteria.name: Evidence and capability correctness
criteria.grade: Pass only when every required bad request is rejected and the valid portable request executes without native substitution

criteria.name: Source and input ownership
criteria.grade: One owner derives or captures identities, verifies changes, and does not edit historical manifests

criteria.name: Caller work
criteria.grade: Count public calls and caller-supplied policy decisions for one complete operation; prefer fewer with equivalent behavior

criteria.name: Migration cost
criteria.grade: List concrete production files/callers to move for first unit and what can remain frozen; no invented delivery time

criteria.name: Failure visibility
criteria.grade: Blocked, unselected unknown, and diagnostic states survive serialization without becoming success

criteria.name: Design red flags
criteria.grade: Audit split ownership, duplicated lists, importable internals, temporal decomposition, and pass-through layers

final_gate: Review the synthesized plan with the user before formal migration or merge
